note: On a shell, an armed Ctrl followed by a typed letter is how a person sends Ctrl-C from a touchscreen. The encoder decides what that becomes; the gate only has to carry the modifiers through. Scoped applies_to pty (gadak GDK-949): on a VNC unicode-insertion pipeline a committed IME unit must never become a control code, so an app conforming at that boundary rightly emits with empty modifiers — an intended difference, not a drift. The machines themselves still carry modifiers through everywhere; both library harnesses run this vector unconditionally.
